acceptanceCriteria.text: AC1 (PO-refined 2026-07-30) - a 'Re-Sync from source' action button is available on the DIAGRAM TOOLBAR (rb-diagram-detail) of the model view (MODEL units only - Diagram/ModelElement - NOT trace units); on Re-Sync, ALL views (tree R32.3 + diagram/edges R32.4/R32.6 + PUML R32.7) AUTO-re-render via the 'rb-model-resynced' event. NO button on the shared rb-trace-tree header (that would leak a feature-button onto /trace, violating the generic-shared-component law - features supply DATA not buttons to the shared tree). A tree-side trigger on a dedicated model host is DEFERRED (R33 backlog).
AC2 - Re-Sync re-runs generation on the model's OWN sourceFile via the EXISTING POST /api/model/generate (TsToModel.generate) - NO new server endpoint, NO fork (client-only action).
AC3 - after Re-Sync, the R32.3 tree re-renders and shows the CURRENT model: added elements appear, removed elements disappear (INV-S2 reconcile: stale-drop + new-add + unchanged rebind).
AC4 - after Re-Sync, the R32.4 diagram surface + the R32.6 relationship edges re-render to the current model.

AC5 - after Re-Sync, the R32.7 exported PUML reflects the current model - TS <-> model <-> PUML consistent (INV-S4 all-views-consistent: tree + diagram + edges + PUML all re-read the one MODEL_STORE).
AC6 / INV-S1 - unchanged elements keep the SAME uuid across re-sync: no duplicate, no re-mint (the R32.2 deterministic keyToUuid rebind + content-compared write; INV-P1/P2 lineage).

AC7 / INV-S3 - Re-Sync mutates ONLY the isolated model-store (data/model-store); prod scenario/index is NEVER touched (the R32.5 safe-mechanism law) - gate-able: prod ModelElement count / git-clean unchanged across sync.
AC8 - Re-Sync with NO source change is idempotent: 0-churn (wrote=0, store byte-identical, all views stable) - by construction from generate()'s content-compared write.

model.acFinalizedNote: 8 ACs FORMALIZED verbatim from the architect handoff (design-mda-model.md ## R32.8, 8e40e79db; INV-S1..S4 finalized) - adopt-not-invent. R32.8 = CLIENT-ONLY 'Re-Sync from source' action: reads model.sourceFile -> re-invokes the EXISTING POST /api/model/generate (TsToModel.generate engine, NO new server code, NO fork) -> explicit re-render of tree (R32.3) + diagram/edges (R32.4/R32.6) + PUML (R32.7) from the single MODEL_STORE. INV mapping: AC6=INV-S1 (deterministic rebind), AC3=INV-S2 (reconcile stale-drop/new-add), AC7=INV-S3 (isolation), AC3+AC4+AC5=INV-S4 (all-views-consistent). All by construction from generate(). The original initial ACs (AC-action-sync / AC-bidirectional-no-drift / AC-same-uuid-throughout) are SUBSUMED (sharpened to the concrete client-re-sync + the four INV-S). Placeholder AC-architect-finalize retired. Anticipated chain (client-render mirror of R32.7 RbTerminalDetail pattern): UC model.sync -> Class (ModelSyncAction / reuse rb-diagram-detail) -> Method reSyncFromSource -> Impl -> Test. IMPL-MINT on build. Version bump (client-only) STILL needs a REAL restart to re-stamp /api/config (R32.7 lesson + R31.7 INV-V4). SCOPE: single-file re-sync (matches R32.5 single-file drop); deleted-file + multi-file DEFERRED to backlog (optional /api/model/sync) - captured separately per PO, NOT a new sprint. THIS CLOSES THE MDA SPRINT.
